Parses the organization response, enforces exact-one cardinality, and returns the selected Moid.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status = "ok"
statusCode = 200
message = "Organization resolved"
resultJson = "{}"
ready = False
organizationMoid = ""
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        raise ValueError("Organization response does not contain a Results array.")
    expectedName = sys.argv[2].strip()
    if len(rows) != 1:
        status = "not-found" if len(rows) == 0 else "conflict"
        statusCode = 404 if len(rows) == 0 else 409
        message = "Organization lookup must return exactly one result; received %d." % len(rows)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message, "resultCount": len(rows)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    elif rows[0].get("Name") != expectedName:
        status = "identity-mismatch"
        statusCode = 409
        message = "Organization response does not preserve the exact requested Name."
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        organizationMoid = str(rows[0].get("Moid") or "")
        if not organizationMoid:
            raise ValueError("The exact organization result has no Moid.")
        resultJson = json.dumps({"organization": rows[0]}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status = "malformed"
    statusCode = 502
    message = str(exc)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True

properties.description: Maps every normalized selector to exactly one accessible local or shared catalog and builds one combined blueprint query.
properties.script:
import json
import sys

status, statusCode, message, resultJson, ready = "ok", 200, "Catalog selectors resolved", "{}", False
resolvedConfigsJson = "[]"
blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'"
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    configs = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    organizationMoid = sys.argv[3]
    rows = body.get("Results") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(rows, list) or not isinstance(configs, list):
        raise ValueError("Catalog response or normalized configuration has the wrong shape.")
    resolved = []
    for config in configs:
        if config["CatalogSelectorType"] == "Moid":
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Moid") == config["CatalogMoid"]]
        else:
            matches = [row for row in rows if row.get("Name") == config["CatalogName"]]
        eligible = []
        for row in matches:
            relation = row.get("Organization")
            relatedMoid = relation.get("Moid") if isinstance(relation, dict) else ""
            if not relatedMoid or relatedMoid == organizationMoid:
                eligible.append(row)
        if len(eligible) != 1:
            status = "not-found" if len(eligible) == 0 else "conflict"
            statusCode = 404 if len(eligible) == 0 else 409
            message = "Each catalog selector must resolve exactly one accessible catalog; selector for %s returned %d. Use CatalogMoid for ambiguous shared/local names." % (config["Name"], len(eligible))
            break
        copy = dict(config)
        copy["ResolvedCatalogMoid"] = eligible[0]["Moid"]
        resolved.append(copy)
    if status == "ok":
        clauses = []
        for config in resolved:
            clause = "Catalog.Moid eq '%s' and Name eq '%s'" % (config["ResolvedCatalogMoid"], config["BlueprintName"].replace("'", "''"))
            clause += " and DefaultVersion eq true" if config["VersionSelection"] == "Default" else " and Version eq %d" % config["Version"]
            clauses.append("(" + clause + ")")
        blueprintUrl = "/api/v1/workload/Blueprints?$filter=" + (" or ".join(clauses) if clauses else "Moid eq '000000000000000000000000'")
        resolvedConfigsJson = json.dumps(resolved, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
        resultJson = json.dumps({"resolvedCatalogCount": len(resolved)}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
    ready = True
except Exception as exc:
    status, statusCode, message = "malformed", 502, str(exc)
    resultJson, ready = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":")), True

    status, statusCode, message = "invalid", 400, "Wait Timeout Seconds must be from 30 through 3600."
    resultJson = json.dumps({"error": message}, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    deadlineEpoch = str(time.time() + timeout)
    resultJson = json.dumps({"timeoutSeconds": timeout, "maximumAttempts": 360}, separators=(",", ":"))
ready = True

properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
attempt = int(sys.argv[2])
remaining = deadline - time.time()
timedOut = remaining <= 0
if not timedOut:
    time.sleep(min(10.0, remaining))
    timedOut = deadline - time.time() <= 0
status, statusCode, message, ready = "ok", 200, "Bounded poll delay completed", True
resultJson = json.dumps({"attempt": attempt, "timedOut": timedOut}, separators=(",", ":"))

Creates one Cisco Unified Edge workload definition version from existing validated workload blueprints and optionally waits for validation. The target needs organization, catalog, blueprint, and workload-definition read/create privileges. Every catalog and blueprint selector is exact; read-only nested RefName values are omitted. Name and generated RefName collision checks cover the whole organization but can race a concurrent create, which the API remains responsible for rejecting. Preferred rollout fields follow CiscoDevNet intersight-python commit 0e8dfdb798aac11684966f0edbbd5e5ea3106dff; live-tenant validation remains required.
